title: Raw Salmon Sesame Temaki
description: Hand-rolled cones of nori with raw salmon, avocado, cucumber and sesame.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Slice salmon suitable for raw consumption, avocado and cucumber into slim batons.
Halve the sheet and distribute approximately 75 g rice diagonally on each half.
Lay salmon, avocado and cucumber over the rice, sprinkle sesame, and optionally add a few drops of sesame oil.
Fold the nori into two cones and eat promptly while the seaweed is crisp.
notes: Toasted sesame oil is optional; use sparingly so it does not overpower the fish.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
